title: Occupation-based-CVD-prediction
summary: A health-survey analysis and predictive-modelling project that studies the link between occupation and cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk using classifiers like logistic regression, random forest, SVM and neural networks. To address class imbalance in the CVD-positive class, its GANs.ipynb notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with a SingleTableMetadata schema) to generate synthetic minority-class records that are then fed into the downstream modelling notebooks.
